📜 Full Lyrics (गीत):

[00:23 - Male Voice]
Dekh le, chehre pe tere ye raat ki roshni,
Hawaon mein ghuli hai teri hi raagini...
Dheemi si raftaar hai aur tu mere paas hai,
Khamosh hain lab magar har lamha khaas hai...

Sheeshe pe girti boondein kehti hain daastaan,
Teri ek muskaan mein simta mera jahaan...
Dhadkan ki ye chaal dekh, dil ka mere haal dekh,
Sun le zara...

[01:04 - Chorus]
Dekh le, bas ek dafa, tu meri jaan ban ja...
Dekh le, is raat mein, tu meri subah ban ja...

[01:26 - Male Voice]
Ungliyon se zulfein jab tu peeche modti hai,
Meri har ek saans aake tujhpe hi rukti hai...
Sadkon ke ye mod saare peeche chhoot jaayenge,
Hum dono is raat ke saaye mein doob jaayenge...

[02:30 - Bridge]
Rok loon main waqt ko yahin,
Tere siwa kuch chahiye nahi,
Bas tera haath ho mere haath mein...

[02:55 - Female Voice Entry]
Sun le tu dil ki sada, tu hi meri har dua...
Tham gaya ye aasmaan, jab se tu mila yahaan...
Teri aankhon ki ye chamak,
Saanso mein hai teri mehak...
Tu jo paas hai mere yahaan,
Haseen ban gaya daastaan...
Dhadkan ki ye chaal dekh, dil ka mere haal dekh,
Sun le zara...

[03:54 - Duet Climax (Both)]
Ho dekh le, bas ek dafa, tu meri jaan ban ja...
Dekh le, is raat mein, tu meri subah ban ja...
Haan dekh le...
